_comment: Unstructured DG0 on a mesh FILE: tests/meshes/square_2x2_tri.msh, the unit square as 8 hand-written Gmsh triangles. Materials by "Cell Sets" (1 = the x < 0.5 half, scatterer; 2 = the x >= 0.5 half, absorber) and BCs by "Face Sets" value (10 bottom, 11 right, 12 top, 13 left): unit isotropic inflow through the left face, the top reflective (axis-aligned, as reflection requires), the rest cold vacuum. Pins the file reader, cell_sets painting and integer-keyed BCs end to end.
